elements.element: The obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “[o]n expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason.”

elements.element: Vendor must provide post-termination transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Vendor must, at Customer’s request, “provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The assistance is required “for up to six months after that expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly applies “Vendor’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor must return all Customer Data.
Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within thirty days after that expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires “a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After return, Vendor must “delete Customer Data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after the return.
elements.evidence: Vendor must “certify the deletion in writing” after return.

elements.element: The obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies on expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Order Form.

elements.element: Vendor must provide post-termination transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Vendor must provide transition assistance at Customer’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance is available for up to six months, which includes the requested 90-day fallback period.
Requiring Vendor to return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format satisfies the data-export requirement.

elements.element: The data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return within thirty days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The added language substantively satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the fallback. It is not minimal and does not fully preserve the surrounding commercial intent because termination of any single Order Form triggers return and deletion of “all Customer Data,” without limiting the obligation to data associated with the terminated Order Form. That could disrupt surviving Order Forms and continuing Services. The absolute deletion obligation may also conflict with Section 16.5’s routine-backup and legal-retention exceptions. The core obligations are otherwise stated clearly, but these scope and consistency defects are substantial.
